activation_condition: Activate only if protocol-developmental-evidence-frontier-blind02-03-v1 passes its frozen Round-4 go/no-go gate without another method change.
activation_procedure: Freeze the final evidence-frontier harness, prompt template, generator, and analysis code by SHA-256.
Replace every TO_BE_BOUND field below, validate the complete protocol, and change protocol_status to frozen-before-task-generation-and-provider-calls.
Place a fresh 256-bit task secret with an independent advisor or automated custodian that does not expose the reveal to the experiment runner.
Only after the frozen protocol is sealed, generate exactly the 12 scheduled tasks and publish their public hashes and hidden-manifest commitment.
Run all 12 tasks in fixed order without inspection-driven replacement or retuning.

excluded_from_confirmation: all opaque-A/opaque-B and bounded development tasks
any task viewed while implementing or debugging evidence-frontier selection
separation_from_development.method_change_after_task_generation: Any semantic method, prompt, selector, budget, or analysis change after task generation terminates confirmation. Results remain reportable as an aborted confirmatory attempt; a revised method requires a new secret and an entirely fresh task set.
separation_from_development.no_peeking_rule: Neither the runner nor model-request process may read target ASTs, family parameters, rejection logs, or the task secret until every provider artifact is sealed.

claim_scope.primary: Whether the frozen GPT-OSS evidence-frontier beam has a higher exact-discovery rate by 29 proposal slots than its matched syntax-uniform random beam on this preregistered 12-task generator distribution.
not_claimed: performance on arbitrary or billion-program spaces outside the frozen grammar/distribution
known or calibrated LLM proposal probabilities

freeze_requirements.no_retuning_rule: No task, call, trajectory, or endpoint may be removed, replaced, rerun, or relabeled because of LLM or random-baseline performance.

model.provider_information_boundary: The model receives one public task, current program, structured interpreter feedback, singleton-derived constraints, the selected repair hole, and the finite legal repair grammar for that hole. It receives no target AST, hidden family, task secret, full program enumeration, search-space cardinality, or outcomes from other confirmation tasks.

fresh_task_generator.program_skeleton: order-preserving filter followed by pointwise arithmetic map
fresh_task_generator.sampling: Derive family parameters and every run seed deterministically from independent domain-separated streams of the advisor-held secret. Generate the first candidate satisfying only the frozen structural checks and log every deterministic rejection privately.
structural_acceptance: target predicate retains three to five observed-domain values
target mapper has at least three distinct values on retained inputs
target predicate differs from the frozen initial predicate on at least two observed-domain values
target mapper differs from the frozen initial mapper on at least two retained inputs
initial complete program is not exact
target components belong to the frozen grammar
target joint finite-domain behavior is unique within blind-v2
forbidden_rejection_reasons: loss magnitude beyond the structural initial-nonexact check
public_examples_in_order: all eight singleton lists in ascending domain order
fresh_task_generator.private_custody: The private reveal must be inaccessible to the experiment runner and provider process until all 12 provider inventories are sealed.

search.selector: After syntax and finite-semantic deduplication, retain the best-loss anchor and the singleton evidence frontier ordered by predicate violations, mapper violations, loss, proposal rank, parent rank, and frozen SHA-256 tie break. Fill any remaining slot by component novelty then the same frontier order.
search.hole_order: violated singleton predicate facts; violated retained-singleton mapper facts; certified predicate toggles; conditional mapper constraints; frozen unsupported fallback
search.schedule_and_invalid_policy: One expansion in Round 1 and exactly two in each later active round. Cycle an underfilled nonempty beam. Each expansion consumes four slots even when invalid, with no retry or backfill.
search.exact_stop: Finish every scheduled expansion in the active round before exact stopping.

matched_random_baseline.policy: Identical task, evidence, hole choices, evidence-frontier selection, K, W, R, slot accounting, stopping, deduplication, and invalid policy; replace only the LLM shortlist with syntax-uniform legal non-no-op repairs without replacement.
matched_random_baseline.seed_derivation: Freeze a domain-separated task/trial/round/expansion/state/hole stream before provider calls.
matched_random_baseline.aggregate_replicates: For matched-random replicate j, sum exact-at-slot-29 indicators from independent task-specific trial-j streams across all 12 tasks.
matched_random_baseline.primary_randomization_p_value: (1 + number of the 10000 aggregate matched-random replicates with successes at least X_LLM) / 10001
required_task_level_reporting: exact count and Wilson interval at slots 21 and 29
invalid calls, physical evaluations, cache hits, and semantic redundancy

confirmatory_endpoints.primary_statistic: X_LLM, the number of the 12 fresh tasks solved exactly by completion of Round 4 at or before proposal slot 29
confirmatory_endpoints.primary_comparison: One-sided preregistered aggregate matched-random randomization test at alpha=0.05
confirmatory_endpoints.practical_effect_threshold: X_LLM must be at least 6 of 12
confirmatory_endpoints.study_success_rule: Both the one-sided matched-random p-value must be at most 0.05 and X_LLM must be at least 6 of 12, with no method-integrity failure.
confirmatory_endpoints.round_3_endpoint: Exact discovery by slot 21 is secondary and descriptive; it cannot replace a failed Round-4 primary endpoint.
confirmatory_endpoints.method_integrity_failure: Any post-generation semantic code/prompt change, target leak, task replacement, unlogged retry, missing task, or baseline-policy mismatch makes the confirmatory result invalid and must be reported as an aborted attempt.
confirmatory_endpoints.estimand_scope: The frozen 12-task balanced generator distribution and model revision only.

reporting.report_infrastructure_failures_twice: once as intention-to-run non-success and once as an operational failure
reporting.reveal_timing: Publish the secret, private target manifest, all rejection logs, and commitment verification only after all provider artifacts are sealed.
required_aggregate_metrics: matched-random aggregate distribution and preregistered p-value
task-level loss and singleton violation trajectories
provider calls, proposal slots, physical evaluations, token usage, elapsed time, and semantic-cell counts
reporting.interpretation_rule: A successful result supports a bounded exact-discovery advantage over the matched random proposal mechanism on the frozen distribution. It does not establish exhaustive-search or billion-space speedup by itself.
